title: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty
summary: Observed by the United Nations on 17 October, this day connects ending poverty with dignity and human rights. The 2026 focus, 'Safe Homes for All', highlights adequate housing. Explore documentaries and films about housing, community and inclusion.
